_comment: Solana mainnet-beta. Every value starting with VERIFY is the owner's to fill in (each says how); deploy and preflight refuse while any remain. Owner decisions (2026-11-02, "waivers" below): no external audit and no multisig before launch, single-key authorities, deposit caps from day one ("caps"); the multi-party key ceremony and the batch committee's key generation stay hard requirements (DEPLOY.md, Before mainnet).
_rpc: The public endpoint: it is written into deploy.mainnet.json and the site config, so it must never carry an API key. Deploy and preflight use RPC_URL instead when it is set (scripts/net.js rpcOf): pass your paid RPC (Helius etc., kept in .env) that way, never in this file.
relayerUrl: VERIFY: the HTTPS URL of your relayer host, no trailing slash (e.g. the Render service's https://<name>.onrender.com, or your own domain). Check: curl -s <url>/health answers {"ok":true,...,"network":"mainnet"} once the relayer runs with deploy.mainnet.json
_mints: Verified 2026-11-02. USDC: Circle's docs (developers.circle.com/stablecoins/usdc-contract-addresses, mainnet table, Solana row) + on chain (getAccountInfo on api.mainnet-beta.solana.com: owner TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA, the classic SPL Token program; decimals 6; mint authority BJE5MMbqXjVwjAF7oxwPYXnTXDyspzZyt4vwenNw5ruG). USDT: Tether's site (tether.to/en/supported-protocols, Solana Blockchain) + on chain (owner the classic SPL Token program, decimals 6, mint authority Q6XprfkF8RQQKoQVG33xT88H7wi8Uk1B1CC7YAs69Gi). SOL is wrapped SOL (native mint). Preflight re-checks owner and decimals on every run.
_prices: USD prices that set each bin pool's opening bin. "live": fetched by the deploy at that moment from CoinGecko and Jupiter's price API, which must agree within 1% (LIVE_PRICE_MAX_SPREAD), else the deploy stops; LAUNCH_PRICES_JSON='{"SOL":<price>}' pins one by hand. USDT is held at its 1 USD peg (USDC is 1 too): usdt-usdc opens at 1.

sealed._comment: Phase 3 sealed batch swaps (slots ~0.4 s). One pool at launch, SOL/USDC, so every sealed swap shares one crowd. Same timings as devnet (150-slot epochs ~1 min, a 1,500-slot ~10 min settlement window, k = 3 per direction, max drift 50 bins = ~5% at bin step 10), with 8 rollovers (~9 min) instead of 4 so a quiet launch-week batch waits for company before it refunds, and minimums of ~$10 so filling a batch with fake participants costs real money. Program limits: epoch and window 1..216,000 slots (window >= 10), k <= 64, minimum < 2^40 atoms. The committee comes from committee/transcript.mainnet.json (a real dealerless DKG among independent operators; preflight is red without it).

caps._comment: Deposit caps while Veyl is new (no external audit yet), in whole tokens; "*" = US dollars for any other token (one the relayer cannot price is not admitted). The relayer's approved-set publisher admits a shielded deposit only within them, oldest first; a refused one stays pending and its depositor can take it back from the app at any time. totalShielded counts what sits in the shielded pool's vault (private positions in bin pools are not included). Change them here (redeploy the relayer) or with the relayer's CAPS_JSON env; no program change needed (relayer/caps.js, DEPLOY.md Deposit caps).

waivers._comment: Owner decisions that turn a mainnet blocker into a warning in preflight (it stays listed). Only these two ids can be waived; the key ceremony, the batch committee and fresh program keys cannot.
waivers.external-audit: Owner decision 2026-11-02: launch without an external audit, with deposit caps ("caps") limiting what is at risk. REVIEW.md is the internal review.
waivers.multisig: Owner decision 2026-11-02: single-key authorities at launch, no multisig. Hand every role from the deployer to one dedicated offline key (npm run handover -- --network mainnet --to <that key>); preflight warns while a role sits on the deployer.
